author: Natalie Ferris
title: "Madden" Trailer: Nicolas Cage and Christian Bale Transform Into John Madden and Al Davis Ahead of Release - NewsBreak
text:
By Natalie Ferris ,
21 hours ago Prime Video has released the full trailer for "Madden," offering a closer look at Nicolas Cage's portrayal of legendary NFL coach and broadcaster John Madden and Christian Bale's performance as Oakland Raiders owner Al Davis.
The trailer debuted Thursday, Sept. 24, ahead of the film's theatrical and streaming release schedule. "Madden" opens in select theaters on Nov. 11 before becoming available worldwide on Prime Video on Nov. 18.
Directed by David O. Russell, the film follows Madden's career from the Raiders sideline to his celebrated broadcasting years and his connection to the football video game franchise that bears his name.
Nicolas Cage and Christian Bale Lead "Madden" Cast The new trailer explores multiple chapters of Madden's life, including his coaching career, television work and involvement with the Madden NFL video game series.
A major focus of the story is Madden's relationship with Davis, whose partnership helped guide the Raiders to a Super Bowl XI championship.
The cast includes Kathryn Hahn as Madden's wife, Virginia, and Sienna Miller as Carol Davis, Al Davis' wife. John Mulaney portrays Electronic Arts founder Trip Hawkins, while Joel Murray plays broadcaster Pat Summerall, Madden's longtime television partner. Comedian Shane Gillis also appears.
The trailer has drawn attention to the physical transformations of Cage and Bale as they step into the roles. Both actors are Academy Award winners, with the film marking another collaboration between Bale and Russell following "The Fighter," "American Hustle" and "Amsterdam."
"Madden" Release Date and Streaming Details The upcoming film will first arrive in select theaters on Tuesday, Nov. 11 before its global Prime Video debut on Tuesday, Nov. 18.
The project was previously introduced with a first teaser released by Amazon MGM Studios on Christmas Day 2025, when the film was promoted with a Thanksgiving 2026 release window. The updated schedule places its limited theatrical run one week before streaming availability.
The theatrical engagement appears connected to awards-season consideration. GoldDerby reported that Amazon MGM planned a qualifying theatrical run, while Rolling Stone, citing Variety, reported that a wide theatrical release was not expected.
John Madden's Legacy Beyond Football Madden became one of football's most recognizable figures after leaving coaching and establishing a long career as a broadcaster.
He also became closely associated with the Madden NFL video game franchise, which launched in 1988 and grew into one of the most successful sports video game series.
Madden died in December 2021 at age 85. His impact on football broadcasting continued through his Thanksgiving Day NFL appearances with Summerall, a tradition referenced in coverage surrounding the film's release.
With Cage and Bale leading the cast, "Madden" brings one of football's most recognizable personalities to the screen while exploring the relationships and career milestones that shaped his public legacy.
